card.name: The 5 in 0.5 after a slash
card.fires_on: The digit 5 right after "0." in a second dose or volume following a slash, as in "2 mg/0.5 mg" or "75 mg/0.5 mL". It appears in combination-strength labels and strength-per-volume labels.

modes.label: Combination strength
modes.description: The 5 of 0.5 mg in a paired strength such as buprenorphine/naloxone 2 mg/0.5 mg.
modes.example: should be progressively adjusted in increments/decrements of 2 mg/0.<<5>> mg or 4 mg/1 mg

modes.label: Strength per volume
